I need the transportation, medical, signal, and engineer representatives to report any load or vehicle-control requirements for today's four moves: clinic cold-storage cases to the medical annex, communications mast to the north relay point, generator to the engineering yard, and routine administrative pallets to the headquarters warehouse.
